questions.text: What is the average length of the longest increasing subsequence of a uniformly random permutation of 3,997 elements? (Settled by averaging 1,000 random permutations.)
How many names are listed in `warnings.__all__` in Python 3.13?
In Python's Unicode database (Unicode 15.1.0), how many code points have the general category Me (enclosing marks)?
How many function definitions (def and async def, counting methods and nested functions) are in the source file of the standard-library module `bdb` in Python 3.13?
Integers are drawn uniformly at random from 1 to 20,895, with replacement, until some value appears for the second time. What is the expected number of draws, counting the repeat?
How many primes p satisfy 1,134,200 ≤ p ≤ 1,145,075?
How many lines are in the source file of the standard-library module `socket` in Python 3.13 (every line, blank or not)?

questions.short: Unicode names with the word MATHEMATICAL
questions.text: In Python's Unicode database (Unicode 15.1.0), how many code points have a name containing the whole word MATHEMATICAL? (Names are split into words at spaces and hyphens.)

A simple random walk on the integers starts at 0 and takes 579 steps of +1 or −1, each with probability ½. What is the expected highest position it reaches (0 if it never rises above the start)? (Settled by averaging 4,000 random walks.)
Starting from 13,994,883,000, how many steps does the Collatz process (halve if even, 3n + 1 if odd) take to reach 1?
Two points are chosen independently and uniformly at random in a 1 × 1.5 rectangle. What is the expected distance between them? (Settled by averaging 400,000 random pairs.)
In Python's Unicode database (Unicode 15.1.0), how many code points in U+16A0–U+16FF (the Runic block) are assigned, that is, have a category other than Cn?
